FIELDS.NAME: Artful Creations Studio
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Art Avenue, Suite 101, Art Town, AT 12345-6789
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artful Creations Studio operates as a creative space dedicated to fostering artistic expression through various activities such as painting, drawing, digital art, and textile crafts. Our studio is designed with artist safety and environmental responsibility in mind, ensuring the use of non-toxic materials and proper storage practices. We maintain robust fire detection systems, including smoke alarms, and meet all local zoning and safety regulations. Our studio offers public workshops where we have established safety protocols and require participant waivers to create a secure environment. With a focus on minimizing risk, we provide secure storage for artwork and customer information while implementing cybersecurity measures for online sales. Our commitment to safety and compliance allows us to cultivate a creative community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses reported as of the current date.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure vault with UL-Listed fire protection, Class 3 rating, equipped with biometric access control and 24/7 monitoring.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured fencing around the property, 24/7 monitored surveillance cameras, and on-site watchpersons during operating hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Artful Creations Studio does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in its operations. The studio focuses exclusively on non-hazardous artistic activities, ensuring a safe environment for creativity.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Artful Creations Studio sponsors local athletic teams as part of our community engagement initiative to support youth activities and promote a healthy lifestyle. We believe in fostering a strong community connection through various sponsorships.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The studio manager, Jessica Thompson, is responsible for checking the certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Artful Creations Studio has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The studio is committed to maintaining a safe and compliant operational environment.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Artful Creations Studio has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. The studio maintains a strong compliance record and commitment to safety.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Artful Creations Studio does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed by the studio.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Artful Creations Studio carries Workers Compensation insurance to ensure the safety and protection of our employees while complying with legal requirements.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Artful Creations Studio does not own or operate any other business; it focuses solely on its creative space dedicated to non-hazardous artistic activities.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Artful Creations Studio currently has a single policy with this company, and there are no additional policies or insurance coverage to list.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Artful Creations Studio is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The studio focuses exclusively on non-hazardous artistic activities such as painting and drawing.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Artful Creations Studio does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on providing a safe space for artistic activities. This helps minimize risks associated with equipment handling and liability.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Artful Creations Studio has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The studio maintains a solid financial standing and has no reported financial distress.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Artful Creations Studio does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals as we focus exclusively on non-hazardous artistic activities and utilize only non-toxic materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Artful Creations Studio does not have any catastrophe exposure, as it focuses exclusively on non-hazardous artistic activities and maintains compliance with local safety regulations. The studio has implemented robust fire safety measures and does not engage in activities that would increase risk.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Artful Creations Studio has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The studio prides itself on maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for all participants and employees.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Artful Creations Studio has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all local fire safety regulations.
